title: UPSC Civil Services Mentorship & Mock Prelims Cohort
message: Orientation session for 3rd and 4th year aspirants eligible for UPSC CSE. Prof. K. Sundaram will review general studies syllabus division and optional subject selection strategies in Seminar Hall 2 this Saturday at 10:00 AM.
sender: Prof. K. Sundaram (Dean of Career Services)

title: CAT / MBA Summer Bootcamp & Quantitative Aptitude Series
message: Exclusive invitation for high CGPA students eligible for IIM CAT 2026. Weekly speed arithmetic workshops and mock interviews will be conducted by alumni from IIM Ahmedabad.

title: Urgent: Remedial Fast-Track Classes for Active Backlog Clearance
message: All students with active backlogs in semesters 1-4 must register for remedial tutoring. Clearing arrears before semester 7 is mandatory for PSU recruitment and Defence NDA/CDS eligibility.

title: Indian Armed Forces (CDS & AFCAT) SSB Screening Preparation
message: Physical fitness and psychological screening practice session for CDS IMA/OTA and AFCAT eligible graduates. Colonel (Retd.) Verma will conduct SSB interview drills.
